fact: Enabel reports that a hospital information system with a computerised medical record was put in place in the district hospitals of Gaya and Gothèye after two field missions in February and April 2024, deployed by the Post-Factum consortium under the PASS Sutura programme, with extension of some modules to urban integrated health centres only to be explored at a mission planned for September 2024.
title: Le Niger avance vers la digitalisation des services de santé avec le projet PASS Sutura
